name: variant-analysis
description: Takes one confirmed bug (path:line plus why it is wrong) and finds every other place in the repository, and optionally across a GitHub owner or local checkouts, where the same root cause appears: one root-cause statement, search axes, a pattern ladder widened one step at a time with ripgrep and local Semgrep rules, per-candidate triage with severity and confidence, a report in $TMPDIR and a Semgrep or rg regression guard. Static only.
